_readme: Edit this file to personalise the gift. No code changes needed. Tokens you can use in any text: {her} {him} {km} {sep} {tetherSep} {tetherFrom} {tetherTo}. Leave names empty to use 'you' / 'me'.

tether.label: Ranchi ↔ Manipal
tether.caption: {km} km on the ground, {tetherSep}° in the sky

intro.title: For {her}
intro.subtitle: Ranchi and Manipal are {km} km apart, yet somehow we're staring at the same sky. {him} built this to prove it. Nerdy? Yes. Worth it? Let's find out.

reveal.cap: Found your sign! Faint at first glance, but the longer you look, the more it glows. Some things just take a little patience to see how bright they are. You're one of them.
reveal.sgr: And that's mine. The Archer, aiming at things far away and occasionally missing. Relatable.
reveal.both: Look at that, only {sep}° apart. The universe clearly didn't get the memo about {km} km.

lockOn.cap: Your sign. Look for a faint, wide crescent with Deneb Algedi at the tail. Soft, steady and lovely once you notice it. Take your time, it's worth it.
lockOn.sgr: My sign. Find the Teapot, the arrow points toward Scorpius. Yes, my sign is a teapot. Let's move on.

bridge.title: The bridge
bridge.text: Capricornus and Sagittarius are neighbours, {sep}° apart. The glowing line joins {tetherFrom} and {tetherTo}. Basically a very dramatic string between two cups.
bridge.sharedMoon: Same Moon, both of us. No, it still won't pick a side.

footer: Made by {him} for {her}. Clear skies required, snacks optional.

ourStars.title: Mine
ourStars.note: The brightest star in my sign, the bottom of the Teapot. Easy to find once you know where to look.

ourStars.title: Yours
ourStars.note: The tail of the Sea-Goat, and the brightest star in your sign. Soft glow, takes a second to notice. Worth the second.

dailyNotes: Same sky tonight, different window. Take a look around 7.
Capricornus is famously hard to spot. You're welcome to prove it wrong.
Starlight is old news by the time it reaches us. This message is fresher.
Cloudy tonight? The stars are still up there. Same as a good plan.
Tonight's challenge: find the Teapot before the app tells you where it is.
Fun fact: the Milky Way is out there tonight. You just have to step away from the lights.
Two cities, one sky. The odds were never better.

wish.text: Shooting star! Make a wish. I won't ask what it was.
